examples.reading: たべてから、くすりをのむ。
examples.gloss: I take the medicine after I eat.

examples.reading: しゅくだいをしてからあそぶ。
examples.gloss: I play after I do my homework.

examples.japanese: 日本に来てから三年になります。
examples.reading: にほんにきてからさんねんになります。
examples.gloss: It has been three years since I came to Japan.

usage: Marks the order of two actions and stresses that the second follows the first.
Also means "since": 来てから三年.
Do not mix it up with から (reason), which attaches to a plain clause.

compare.difference: から (reason) attaches to a plain clause and gives a cause. てから attaches to the て-form and gives an order.
たら means "if" or "when". てから is a plain "after".
